name: Seonix
summary: AI SEO tool that audits your site, suggests keywords and writes and schedules articles for you.
best_for: site owners who want a free audit and keyword ideas first, and small teams ready to pay for 30 AI articles a month on a single site
skip_if: your site is static with no publishing connection, you need several sites on one plan, or you want an article writer we have tested end to end
honest_knock: The AI writing is not on the free plan. The free scan covers a part of larger sites, 100 of our 285 pages. One issue pointed at an image URL instead of our page, and the tool promised fixes it cannot make on a static site. The refund does not apply once anything is generated.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per monthly, Starter is $49 a month, listed against a $100 regular price, or $470 a year instead of $1,200
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on seonix.ai/pricing) Seonix has a free plan, a Starter plan and a custom Enterprise plan. Free costs $0 and covers a full website SEO audit, site health and page speed monitoring, an AI business profile, checks for broken links, duplicates and missing meta tags, an AI-search readiness check, and Search Console and GA4 analytics. Starter costs $49 a month, shown against a $100 regular price, or $470 a year shown against $1,200. It includes 1 website project, 30 AI articles a month, 50 AI edits a day, 5 AI cover images a day, auto-publish on a schedule, keyword research, the site audit and support. Enterprise is priced through sales and lists unlimited projects and content generation. The page mentions no free trial. First-time subscribers can ask for a refund within 14 days of the first payment, but only if nothing has been generated on the account. Monthly article limits do not roll over, and cancelling keeps access to the end of the paid period with no prorated refund. We did not buy Starter, so we do not know how the 30 articles read.
